# ethereum-optimism/optimism Daily Update (Apr 1, 2026)
## OVERVIEW 
Today's development focused on enhancing fault proof systems, fixing critical bugs in the derivation pipeline and acceptance tests, and improving documentation for historical proofs.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

### Fault Proof System Enhancements
Significant progress was made in the fault proof system, converting all `op-e2e` fault proof tests to use `CANNON_KONA` and `SUPER_CANNON_KONA` game types, utilizing `kona-host` instead of `op-program` ([#19791](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19791)). Additionally, a fix was implemented to pass the `depset` configuration to the `kona` super executor, enabling it to detect expired messages ([#19849](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19849)).

### Derivation Pipeline and Node Stability Fixes
Several critical bugs were addressed to improve the stability and correctness of the derivation pipeline and node operations. This includes fixing a pipeline initialization bug where `kona` used an incorrect system config during reset ([#19792](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19792)), and ensuring `L2ContractsManager` cannot declare storage variables to prevent collisions via a new Semgrep rule ([#19649](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19649)). A fix was also implemented to send the `L2Transactions` hint before the trie walk during block re-execution in `kona` ([#19850](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19850)).

### Acceptance Test and RPC Stability Improvements
Efforts were made to enhance the reliability of acceptance tests and RPC services. Flaky tests like `TestSupernodeInteropChainLag` and `TestUnsafeChainNotStalling_DisabledReqRespSync` had their `MarkFlaky` tags removed after showing recent stability ([#19846](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19846)). A specific flake in `eth_simulateV1` acceptance tests was also resolved ([#19842](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19842)). For RPC, the proofs ExEx state provider was updated to error if state is unavailable, rather than falling back to a historical provider ([#19855](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19855)).

### Documentation and Build Process Refinements
Documentation for historical proofs was significantly enriched with context, architecture, metrics, and benchmarks ([#19790](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19790)). The build process saw a simplification by replacing a Go script for `nut-bundle-check` with a more concise `git diff` approach ([#19852](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19852)).

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
- [#19882](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19882) fix: predeploys order after rev share removal
- [#19881](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19881) fix(op-node): bypass event system for sequencer→engine path
- [#19880](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19880) supernode: Use Denylist Output for "OptimisticOutputRoot"
- [#19879](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19879) op-acceptance-tests: use Go table tests instead of env vars
- [#19878](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19878) [DRAFT] Add OPCM upgrades doc page
- [#19877](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19877) [DRAFT] Update op-deployer upgrade command details
- [#19876](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19876) fix(op-service/sources): release receipts fetch lock on inner error
- [#19874](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19874) fix(kona/protocol): add TxGases span decode error for gas varints
- [#19872](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19872) test: zk dispute game factory and registry
- [#19871](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19871) fix(op-service/sources): remove dead ToBlockID in FetchReceipts
- [#19869](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19869) fix(contracts-bedrock): correct min/max base fee require message in SystemConfig
- [#19867](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19867) fix(contracts-bedrock): correct minOwners require message in LivenessModule
- [#19865](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19865) fix(op-service/eth): use Blob label in UnmarshalFixedText
- [#19863](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19863) fix(op-service/eth): correct Bytes256 UnmarshalFixedText type name
- [#19861](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19861) fix(op-node/p2p): close all block gossip topics on publisher shutdown
- [#19857](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19857) fix(op-batcher): update oldest L1 origin using oldest, not latest
- [#19856](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19856) fix(op-node/derive): subtract channel size only when pruning frames
- [#19854](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19854) feat!(rust): upgrade alloy-evm to 0.30.0, bump reth to 082c36e, remove op feature
- [#19851](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19851) fix(kona): cache replacement block receipts during consolidation

## CLOSED ISSUES

### Fault Proof System and Cannon Updates
Several issues related to the fault proof system and Cannon were closed. This includes fixing host arguments in the Kona super executor ([#18287](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18287)) and investigating Go 1.26 compatibility for Cannon ([#19164](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19164)).

### Contract and Test Reliability Improvements
Issues concerning contract conventions and test flakiness were resolved. Documentation was added for the `no-storage-variables` convention in `L2ContractsManager` ([#19391](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19391)). A flaky `TestEthSimulateV1` test was also addressed ([#19836](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19836)).

### OPCM Migration
An issue related to migrating FaultDisputeGame chains to SuperDisputeGame within OPCM was closed ([#19013](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19013)).

## NEW ISSUES

### Kona Output Root Mismatch
A new issue reports a `kona` output root mismatch after deposit-only block replacement during message expiry consolidation, where the resulting super root does not match the supernode's validated super root ([#19848](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19848)).

### EIP-7843 Support and `revm` Upgrade
There's a new issue regarding supporting EIP-7843 `slot_num` in `BlockEnv` for the OP Stack, following the `revm` upgrade to v36, where the `slot_num` field is currently hardcoded to `0` in `alloy-op-evm` ([#19853](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19853)).

### Flaky Tests
Two new flaky tests were reported: `TestFlashblocksStream` ([#19883](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19883)) and `TestUnsafeGapFillAfterSafeReorg` ([#19884](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19884)).

### Derivation and Service Component Fixes
Several issues were opened to track fixes for various components:
- `op-batcher`: oldest L1 origin compared against latest instead of oldest ([#19859](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19859)).
- `op-node/derive`: channel size incorrect when pruning frames after the last frame ([#19858](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19858)).
- `op-node/p2p`: gossip publisher does not close `blocksV3`/`blocksV4` on shutdown ([#19860](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19860)).
